{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_bubble_chart.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Service measurements
services = {
    'Alpha': {'latency': 80, 'accuracy': 0.91, 'requests': 1200, 'cost': 0.06},
    'Beta': {'latency': 120, 'accuracy': 0.94, 'requests': 800, 'cost': 0.09},
    'Gamma': {'latency': 60, 'accuracy': 0.88, 'requests': 1600, 'cost': 0.04},
    'Delta': {'latency': 150, 'accuracy': 0.96, 'requests': 600, 'cost': 0.12},
    'Epsilon': {'latency': 95, 'accuracy': 0.92, 'requests': 1000, 'cost': 0.07}
}

# Extract data
latencies = [services[name]['latency'] for name in services]
accuracies = [services[name]['accuracy'] for name in services]
areas = [services[name]['requests'] / 2 for name in services]
costs = [services[name]['cost'] for name in services]
names = list(services.keys())

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6), dpi=120)

# Create scatter plot with bubbles
scatter = ax.scatter(
    latencies, 
    accuracies, 
    s=areas, 
    c=costs, 
    cmap='viridis',
    vmin=0.04, 
    vmax=0.12,
    alpha=0.7,
    edgecolors='black'
)

# Add colorbar
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax)
cbar.set_label('Cost per Request ($)')

# Annotate each bubble with service name
for i, name in enumerate(names):
    ax.annotate(
        name,
        (latencies[i], accuracies[i]),
        xytext=(5, 5),
        textcoords='offset points',
        fontsize=10,
        fontweight='bold'
    )

# Set labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Latency (ms)')
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
ax.set_title('Service Quality and Load')
ax.set_ylim(0.85, 0.98)

# Add dashed grid
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as figure.png")

# Show the figure
plt.show()
EOF
"}

names = list(services.keys())

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6), dpi=120)

# Create scatter plot with bubbles
scatter = ax.scatter(
    latencies, 
    accuracies, 
    s=areas, 
    c=costs, 
    cmap='viridis',
    vmin=0.04, 
    vmax=0.12,
    alpha=0.7,
    edgecolors='black'
)

# Add colorbar
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax)
cbar.set_label('Cost per Request ($)')

# Annotate each bubble with service name
for i, name in enumerate(names):
    ax.annotate(
        name,
        (latencies[i], accuracies[i]),
        xytext=(5, 5),
        textcoords='offset points',
        fontsize=10,
        fontweight='bold'
    )

# Set labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Latency (ms)')
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
ax.set_title('Service Quality and Load')
ax.set_ylim(0.85, 0.98)

# Add dashed grid
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Figure saved as figure.png')
print(f'Figure size: 8x6 inches at 120 dpi')
print(f'Number of services: {len(services)}')
print(f'X-axis: Latency (ms) - range: {min(latencies)} to {max(latencies)}')
print(f'Y-axis: Accuracy - range: {min(accuracies):.2f} to {max(accuracies):.2f}')
print(f'Colorbar: Cost per Request ($) - range: 0.04 to 0.12')
print(f'Colormap: viridis')
